completed_unit.target: Cargo build-script override via target.<triple>.<links> configuration
completed_unit.finding: Cargo's official Build Scripts reference states that if a package manifest declares a links key, Cargo supports overriding that build script through target-specific config keyed by the links value. With such an override, Cargo does not compile or run the package build script and instead uses the supplied link/config/environment/metadata values. This removes build.rs execution only for the bounded class of packages whose manifest declares the matching links key and only when the required replacement metadata/config is supplied for the active target.
completed_unit.verified_scope: For a package declaring links=foo, a matching [target.<triple>.foo] Cargo configuration can prevent that package's build script from being compiled or run and substitute declared metadata for that target.
limitations: This mechanism does not establish a generic way to disable arbitrary build.rs scripts for packages without a links key.
Correctness still depends on supplying semantically sufficient replacement link/search/cfg/env/metadata values for the package and target.

The source verification does not prove equivalence for packages whose build script performs code generation, native compilation, discovery, or other side effects not fully represented by the override metadata.
Actual Cargo/rustc execution inside scheduled Chat remains unresolved and was not attempted in this slice.
completed_unit.scope_guard: Do not generalize target.<triple>.<links> override into universal build-script suppression or end-to-end Chat-native Rust build parity.

public_source.source_claim: A package with a links key can have its build script overridden by acceptable Cargo config for the target; when matched, the build script is not compiled or run and configured metadata is used instead.

frontier.current_target: Determine whether a Cargo-native mechanism exists for packages without a links key, or whether that package class remains a hard build-script-execution blocker.
